name: Högstad - Strömstad
description: Högstad to Strömstad. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
utilities: Koster waiting hall toilet, Norra Hamnen (toilet)
waterSources: Strömstad guest harbour services: Guest harbour services include water on piers, toilet/shower access for harbour users and waste/recycling by harbour office/Torskholmen.
notes: The official direct GPX filename is Etapp27_Krokstrand_stromstad.gpx, but current WST/Naturkartan/Västsverige/PDF/ArcGIS identity and endpoints are Högstad - Strömstad.
Västsverige text/PDF confirm 15 km Högstad - Strömstad, but embedded KMZ/KML is only about 10.009 km, starts about 5.304 km along the official route and ends about 292 m from the WST endpoint.
WST and Naturkartan give 5 h, while Västsverige says approximately 4-5 h.

Strömstad endpoint has possible taps/harbour services, but official WST dricksvatten category exposes no Stage 27 water POI and Strömstad/Västsverige context says local Bohusleden sections lack natural water or drinking water.
AllTrails shows a medium route page but one recent user called it easy; route-app lengths differ from the official rounded 15 km.
Before import, refresh WST status API and Naturkartan page for any Stage 27 deviation or closure.

facilities.name: Etapptavla Högstad
facilities.description: Official stage information board at the Högstad start / Stage 26-27 junction.

facilities.name: Vindskydd Rogstad / Rogstad Hillern
facilities.description: Shelter with sleeping places on the marked Rogstad/Hillern viewpoint detour. Official route calls this a short marked detour and Strömstad/third-party sources corroborate the shelter cluster. Import as shelter/rest facility, not as a formal campsite unless signage/manager confirms campsite status. No potable water confirmed.

facilities.name: Rogstad / Hillern fireplace
facilities.description: Prepared fireplace/grill at the Rogstad/Hillern shelter cluster. Strömstad source notes winter firewood storage below the shelter. Fire bans and local signage override mapped fireplace status.

facilities.name: Rogstad / Hillern viewpoint
facilities.description: Viewpoint/shelter area with bench/view toward Strömstad; WST categorizes the place with viewpoint context.

facilities.name: Informationstavla Ekemyr
facilities.description: Information board near Ekemyr close to a small parking/access point late in the stage. Parking should be modeled as access metadata unless exact capacity/legal status is verified.

facilities.name: Strömstad station
facilities.description: Rail and bus hub essentially at the official Strömstad endpoint.

facilities.name: Strömstad & Kosterhavet / Infocenter
facilities.description: Tourist information / InfoCenter near Strömstad harbour. Physical tourist office and InfoPoints have season/opening caveats.

facilities.name: Koster waiting hall toilet, Norra Hamnen
facilities.description: Public/visitor toilet in the Koster boats waiting hall beside the tourist office/Norra Hamnen. Endpoint city-service facility; check opening/season if strict public availability is required.

facilities.name: Strömstad guest harbour services
facilities.description: Guest harbour services include water on piers, toilet/shower access for harbour users and waste/recycling by harbour office/Torskholmen. Access may be harbour-user/fee/code based; do not import as unconditional free public water/toilet. Water is high reliability when harbour water is on, but seasonal/opening/current access must be verified.

facilities.name: Strömstads Badanstalt
facilities.description: Indoor pool/bathhouse in central Strömstad, near the endpoint.

facilities.name: Strömstads Kallbadhus
facilities.description: Sea bath/cold bath on the Strömstad promenade; tourism page says free entry June-August.

facilities.name: Strömstads Camping / First Camp City
facilities.description: Commercial campground near the Strömstad endpoint, not an official free Bohusleden trail campsite.

facilities.name: Strömstad food and resupply cluster
facilities.description: Endpoint-city commercial food/resupply options, including ICA Nära, Coop, Eurocash and Willys within practical Strömstad access range. Model as endpoint service/resupply cluster rather than importing every city shop as a route facility unless the app supports dense service layers.

facilities.name: Strömstad central lodging cluster
facilities.description: Endpoint-city commercial lodging options near the route end, including Crusellska, Krabban, Anitas B&B and Scandic.

source.provider: official WST/Hoodin GPX or identical WST map API GeoJSON
